LESSON: MUSICAL INSTRUMENTS

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Musical Instruments

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Musical Instruments. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.
